# Intent Capture Questions

## Sources

- [desc] Initial description: "Add an optional due date to tasks and mark overdue tasks in the list output"
- [scope] Workflow-selected scope: `poc`.

## Q1. What problem does this solve, and for whom?

Today the task list has no way to say when a task is due, so nothing tells you a task is late.

A. Me alone: I forget tasks that have a deadline and only notice too late
B. Me and a few others who share this tool: we miss deadlines on shared tasks
C. A team or users I support: they asked for deadlines on tasks
D. Not yet defined: it is mainly a proof that the idea works
X. Other (please specify)

[Answer]: A. Me alone: I forget tasks that have a deadline and only notice too late

## Q2. What does success look like for this first version?

This tells us how to judge the result when it is done.

A. I can add a task with a due date, and late tasks are clearly marked when I list them
B. Same as A, plus old task files without due dates still work unchanged
C. Same as B, plus I can change or remove a due date later
D. Not yet defined
X. Other (please specify)

[Answer]: A. I can add a task with a due date, and late tasks are clearly marked when I list them

## Q3. Why do this now?

A. I keep missing deadlines and want a fix soon
B. Someone asked for it
C. It is a small, safe change to try out this way of working
D. Not identified
X. Other (please specify)

[Answer]: A. I keep missing deadlines and want a fix soon

## Q4. Who decides what goes in, and who else cares about the result?

A. Only me: I decide and I am the only user
B. I decide; a few friends or colleagues use it and give feedback
C. Someone else decides (please name the role); I build it
D. Not identified
X. Other (please specify)

[Answer]: A. Only me: I decide and I am the only user

## Q5. Does anyone need progress updates while this is built?

A. None: no updates needed
B. Just a short note when it is done
C. Regular updates (please say how often and to whom)
D. Not applicable
X. Other (please specify)

[Answer]: A. None: no updates needed

## Q6. What should this first version leave out? (select all that apply)

The workflow is already set to a small proof of concept (`poc`). This question is only about what the feature itself should not do yet.

A. Reminders or alerts (only marking in the list output)
B. Due times (date only, no hour or minute)
C. Sorting or filtering tasks by due date
D. Editing or removing a due date after the task is added
E. None: nothing specific to leave out
X. Other (please specify)

[Answer]: A. Reminders or alerts (only marking in the list output)
